data.title: Speed challenge: tidy up usernames
story: Write a function make_username(name): remove spaces at the edges, make it lowercase, and replace the spaces in the middle with _.
Example: " Budi Santoso " becomes "budi_santoso". Hidden tests try capital letters and text that is only spaces.

explanation: Order matters: .strip() first so edge spaces do not turn into _, then .lower() and .replace(" ", "_"). Text that is only spaces automatically becomes empty text.
hints: There are three steps: remove edge spaces, lowercase, replace middle spaces.
If .replace runs before .strip(), the edge spaces turn into _ too.
